starterOrdering: Editorial progression from practical requests to nuanced formal reading; not a certified CEFR placement.
starterContent: Original sense-specific English definitions, Urdu meanings, complete contextual examples, combinations and usage distinctions.
catalogueQuality: Inherited content is preserved; not all definitions, translations or examples have received a new sense-by-sense editorial review. Dictionary references remain English-only.
extendedOrdering: Internal bands, then source frequency, example completeness and lexical complexity; not an externally validated difficulty scale.
classificationPolicy: Specific labels only for reviewed senses; otherwise General vocabulary by user instruction. Fallback does not verify inherited content.
